## [IITM Unicorn Frontier Fund I](https://www.iitmunicornfrontier.com/)

The IITM Unicorn Frontier Fund-I represents India’s first strategic integration between a premier research institution and a venture capital fund.

Unicorn India Ventures (UIV) manages this ₹600 Crore corpus (+ ₹400 Cr Greenshoe), bringing institutional capital discipline and global exit capability to the table.

IIT Madras serves as the strategic anchor, providing technical validation and deep science innovation. Together, we bridge the gap between "Lab Bench" and "Global Boardroom."

[Know More](https://www.iitmunicornfrontier.com/)

# Fund III

We are delighted to announce the first close of Unicorn India Ventures’ third fund in very difficult global market conditions. We are grateful to our family of investors – HNIs, Family Offices, institutions in their abiding faith in us, their unwavering belief in the India story and their generosity to power dreams and transform lives.

### Genrobotics - Uplifting The Lives Of Unheard People

Genrobotics specializes in designing solutions that address pressing social issues by seamlessly combining robotics and artificial intelligence. With the introduction of Bandicoot, their flagship product, hundreds of sanitation workers, who were forced to work in highly inhuman conditions, started working as robot operators.

[Know more](https://www.genrobotics.org/)
